text: Hey Wendell. I like your content, I like you. The review is fair. I got convinced myself. But god damn it do I regret it. I've spent so many, many hours in the past two months troubleshooting, reading forums, talking with technicians. Nothing fixed my issues. Two straight months of constant driver timeouts in WoW. The issue only got better with WoW's latest patch but Blizzard not prioritizing to fix the issue on their end just says something about AMD products. I've sent numerous reports to AMD, hundreds even and I've never gotten an email back. Spending so much on a GPU to have an experience this bad is just depressing. I've tried everything in the world to get the thing stable but the only way to fix it was to revert to DX11, which came with a huge performance hit. I didn't even know what hardware acceleration is before. Now I've had to disable it on all the programs I could. Perhaps reviewers should warn their viewers of these things as an asterisk at the end of their videos. AMD just doesn't have a big enough userbase. Companies won't prioritize fixing their issues when 80% of their users are on NVIDIA cards. AMD won't get as much data out of an issue to fix it fast enough. I wanted to believe in AMD so much, I wanted to believe it will run as smoothly as all the reviewers said (like Luke from LTT saying he forgot he changed his card) but when it comes to where I spent my money, I'm extremely disappointed. Freakin' hell, I did everything right. I did my research, I double checked for any errors when building my PC. Nothing fixes the damn TDR issue. And it's a long-standing one if all my time searching in google, reddit, amd and blizzard forums says anything.

text:
PSA!!! TECHSPOT’s 7800XT COOLER COMPARISON IS STRAIGHT UP WRONG.
 I’ve been digging for a while during this launch, snagging a 7800xt nitro+ and doing my due diligence. Basically every delta for every 7800xt card is 20 degrees, even the reference model. Only differences between the AIBs are optimal FAN SPEEDS or fan speed adjusted cooling capacity that are being ignored by every single reviewer except vex, who I believe has some flaw in his hotspot recording software because 10 degree deltas just seems to be unrealistically low for this series. Idk why the goat gamers nexus completely ignored temperatures.
Techspot has by far the most 7800xt aib models compared against each other, but again I suspect something is off. eTechNix showed live benchmarks between the MERC and the nitro 7800xt, with both having 20 degree delta except the MERC ran at 1600 rpm while the nitro avged 1000, which is an insane difference. Literally means the nitro should have at least a 30% more effective cooling solution. Live feedback means that we can actually trust that data’s validity, which is sadly not the case with website reviews it seems. Techspot shows the MERC outperforming the nitro at basically the same fan speed, so sadly we can deduce that chart is fucked. Hellhound is definitely an amazing card, but they’re reporting inaccurate benchmarks for some reason.
